name: Go-Jirakawa Houou
source:
Emperor Go-Shirakawa was the fourth prince of Emperor Toba. He was the fourth prince of Emperor Toba and administered government for 34 years after succeeding to the throne.

He was an eccentric person who favored "Ima-sama," a style of popular song that was unusual for an aristocrat. He was also a man of authority and intrigue, and when it came to matters of politics, he had a sense of authority that would not let him down. He was also a master of politics, and his authority and scheming were very powerful...
